yuen.name: 尤恩

arguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, style-transfer.
This is the ONE targeted revision of a medieval game dialogue portrait. Image 1 is the v1 portrait to revise. Image 2 is the original full-body identity master, for identity only. Images 3–6 are the four approved low-resolution style references, for coarse pixel construction only.
Requested changes: Keep the sixty-year-old receding all-white hair, short connected white moustache/beard, long drooping nose, narrow old cheeks, low eyelids and subtly raised inner brows of this hesitant elder. Change the white hair and beard into just a few broad, unified flat shapes with gray shadows: no repeated strips, streaks, whiskers, or isolated dot highlights. Make the eyes darker and smaller. Preserve PLUM PURPLE as a clearly distinct muted plum patch in the NARROW scarf/collar, noticeably different from the brown outerwear even at 32 colors; only modestly increase plum saturation, do not expand the clothing area. Keep the tiny old pin. Shorten the exposed neck so the chin is immediately above the narrow scarf. Expression remains thoughtful hurt and hesitation, not generic cheerful elder or hostile frown.
Keep identity, age, hairline, nose/cheek shape, direction and facial attitude. Redraw substantively with stronger low-resolution economy, not merely upscale or recolor.
Composition: one VERY LARGE head, near-front gentle three-quarter facing viewer left. Entire hair crown and all ear contours intact. Allow at least 3 logical transparent pixels on ALL sides of the RAW image, including below the collar. Logical 74x100 canvas: crown starts at y=3; forehead/face should occupy most of canvas; chin/beard around y=87–89; short neck and narrow garment edge end by y=96. Reduce extra hair bulk rather than shrinking the face. No shoulder silhouette or bust.
Draw directly in chunky hard-edged small-grid pixel shapes with broad continuous skin planes, limited to 32 flat muted earthy colors. Prefer one deliberate large shadow shape to many separated micro-clusters. NO smooth gradients, blurry shading, antialiasing, dithering, fine texture, strand lines, dotted highlights or big white eye blocks. Transparent background only. No props, tools, hands, scenery, text, borders, watermark. One portrait.

yuen.identity_reconciliation: 现卡约60岁全白发、旧式长褂、童年围巾与旧徽优先旧母图灰白发/无围巾；保退发际、长下垂鼻、白短胡及梅色衣棕外衣。难过停顿而非抢孩子的长辈。
limitations: 额眉皱纹线仍稍多，白发仍有少量连续条带；眼白保留小亮块。
原raw右侧余量15源像素，selected inset提供更稳候选留边，不是源图修复。
